# Uditya Pal — Full-Stack Developer

> Portfolio of Uditya Pal (Aman Pal), a Full-Stack MERN Developer from Greater Noida, India.
> MCA graduate (CGPA 8.50) open to software engineering roles.

## About

Uditya builds production-grade web applications with React, Next.js, Node.js,
Express, MongoDB, PostgreSQL and TypeScript. Interests include real-time
collaborative tools, AI-powered platforms, design systems and assessment engines.
